metric: Of 3,000 cases (every eighth of 23,994), the 1,628 the prover does not prove outright with the spec's own types, keys, NOT NULL columns and foreign keys (1,372 are proved outright): 338 proved under a minimal set of extra NOT NULL, unique-key and foreign-key conditions, 1,280 unknown (10 more are conditional proofs that rest on a composite foreign key the executed check cannot impose; they are not scored).
correctness: 0 wrong, 0 crashed: every conditional proof re-run on 900 random DuckDB databases repaired to meet its conditions and on the executed counterexample search with the conditions in the spec, both with no difference; the prover loses each proof when any one condition is dropped; 116 are separated by a database that breaks the conditions
caveats: A sample, not the whole set (3,000 of 23,994 cases). Proof under assumed conditions beyond the declared ones. No held-out split reserved; the harness was developed against Singh dev pairs and an early 80-case sample (tuned on test). Conditions beyond the spec are rarer than on the Singh pairs because the declared keys already carry what the prover can use. Measured 2026-10-04. Against master on the same sample this is 23 fewer conditional proofs: the constant-result check used to stop on VeriEQL type names, which left it unable to run, and 24 proofs it now rejects hold only because the returned conditions make both queries return one result on every test database (a unique key on a self join that asks for two different rows); one proof was gained. Re-measured 2026-11-17 on Kumo_SQL_Prover PR 36 (commit dd53ffe, 3,000 cases, 2,338 s): 1,372 proved outright (866), 338 conditional (297), 1,280 unknown (1,837), 10 not re-checkable, 0 wrong; 338/338 re-checked on databases that meet the conditions. The proved-outright and unknown counts include the VeriEQL worker rules and everything else merged into main since 2026-10-04; the change was not separated.
